attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- design seed: palari-expansion-03-081
- identity: bean-curved charcoal pod with a diagonal green leaf and greeting arm

- crown: simple closed dome with no open top
- opening: one asymmetric leaf-shaped opening, diagonally oriented
- pose: one curved arm raised in greeting, ending in one seamless oval tip; the other rounded arm rests close to the body
- expression: curious
- exterior material: near-black charcoal ceramic with broad readable highlights and visible microtexture
- characteristic color: deep forest green (#174D38)

Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated full-body figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the single recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening and no unrelated holes
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, forest-green iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one clearly readable Palari seed mark on the lower torso: exactly six circular apertures arranged as four larger circles at the corners of a compact rectangle plus exactly two smaller circles centered vertically between them; the six apertures are forest green and are not a grille
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: direct 1:1 square; eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; full figure visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height with generous margin; no crop.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Reduce palari-081 to a compact symbol: a bean-curved closed pod shell wrapping one large diagonal leaf-shaped inner aperture. The shell-and-aperture silhouette is the primary identity. Retain the Palari seed as a very small secondary family signature.

Color count: EXACTLY THREE semantic colors in the complete image, with no other hues:
1. warm ivory #E9E6DF for the entire outer shell and the six seed circles,
2. forest green #174D38 for the single continuous leaf aperture,
3. deep navy #172333 for the perfectly uniform edge-to-edge background and for the two tiny eye cutouts.

Make every tip blunt and rounded; no thin lines or fragile gaps. The solid silhouette and diagonal aperture must remain immediately legible at 32 × 32.

Composition: direct upright 1:1 square with square canvas corners. The mark emerges from and intentionally crops into the lower-right corner, filling about 80% of the canvas; preserve the complete dome and diagonal leaf identity. No separate sticker, card, frame, badge, container, App-icon mask, rounded canvas corners, or border.

Style: Flat-first vector-friendly geometry with only extremely subtle continuous-gradient micro-volume inside each large IP color region, one shared broad upper-left-to-lower-right light direction.
